family: The SAME total uniform P language F_N=family.evaluate on ALL N actual bits, defined fully in family.py. d_N is its fixed public controller's original minimum geometry dimension; fallback is output0,d_N=N+1. Its fixed empty-witness NP verifier is given in proof.md.
theorem: At acceptance, write the active depths as a_0=0<...<a_hp=H, with public products V_j. Let c_u=ceil(N/2^V_(a_u)), T_u=2^(V_(a_(u+1))-V_(a_u)), and Q be its original exact geometry maximum from proof.md. Set M_hp=c_hp+1 and M_u=min(c_u+1,M_(u+1)+(T_u-1)(Q-1)); e_N=M_0 at acceptance, otherwise e_N=N+1. Then In the pinned full B2 model, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-8e_N+8 for EVERY integer N>=0. At EVERY sufficiently large integer length, d_N<=2^ceil(DZ), D=8818127579/2000000000, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)), L=ceil(log2 N), B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Also limsup log2(d_N)/Z<=Cstar6<=440906378851/100000000000, where Cstar6=inf_(S6)(w0+X) and S6 is explicitly defined in proof.md. For each fixed real epsilon>0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer N; this SAME family has liminf C_B2(F_N)/N>=4. At acceptance e_N<=d_N-(Q-1-c_hp)<d_N.
